description: Date change within 3 days of requested date is auto-approved
Date change of 4-14 days needs planner approval
Date change over 14 days needs planner endorsement + ops manager approval
Quantity shortfall up to 5% of ordered qty is auto-approved
Shortfall over 20% needs planner endorsement + ops manager approval
Price change of 2-10% needs planner approval
Price change over 10% needs planner endorsement + ops manager approval
Any change moving line value by more than USD 50,000 escalates to ops manager
Proposed date earlier than PO order date is rejected by the system
